responsibility: This installed runtime header is the public ACLE entry point for AArch64 SME intrinsics and streaming-compatible library hooks. It includes `arm_sve.h`, invokes `#pragma GCC aarch64 "arm_sme.h"` so the compiler injects the SME types and intrinsic declarations from its builtin framework, and declares the small fixed set of runtime support functions such as `__arm_za_disable` and streaming-compatible memory routines that accompany the SME language interface.
